2.why: src/Pul5es.cpp process(): clamp(rescale(getVoltage(), 0, 10, 2, 256), 2, 256), written back into the knob

3.why: src/Pul5es.cpp process(): inLoop.process(getVoltage(), 0.01f, 2.f), or a level compare against 0.2f under the gate option

comment: The trigger thresholds here are 0.01V low and 2V high rather than Rack's usual 0V and 1V, so a source that only reaches 1V never clocks this module. The OUT ON CV writes its result straight back into the knob every sample, so the knob cannot be moved by hand while a cable is in that jack. The README describes the loop jack only inside an HTML comment, so the published text does not mention it although the jack is on the panel and works. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
